title: listing and asset_sale have no owning schema in the P1 table list
source: WP B2-P1-005; RWB-DM-006 data table; context pack P1 ownership rows
section: 1 Story, 11 Data, 12.7 Tables owned, 19 Out of scope
description: Legacy RWB-DM-006 migrates listing and asset_sale, and its data table gives them DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-019, but neither table is in the 18 tables the Ownership Map gives P1 rwb-source-data. The story therefore cannot say which service's schema serves them, and the legacy AC1 assumes one migration writes both.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-006 Data table: listing DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-008; asset_sale DF-SAL-009 to DF-SAL-019. Context pack P1 ownership rows list account_ext, case_list_row, contact_point_ext, data_contract, data_product, data_product_access, data_product_load, dp_guarantee_claim, dp_treatment, efs_ledger_outcome, interaction, lake_copy_watermark, party_ext, reconciliation_result, sys_field_version, sys_fields, sys_objects, valuation_ext; listing and asset_sale are absent.
owner_role: Data architect; S5 rwb-asset technical owner
proposed: Confirm S5 rwb-asset as owner of listing and asset_sale, keep this story to valuation_ext and the DP06 read path, and validate asset_key links against the rwb-asset contract fake.

title: Retention period of the legacy tables after cutover is not given
description: AC3 requires the legacy tables to stay read-only for their retention period, but no source states the period for the legacy listing, sale instruction and appraisal acceptance tables.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-006 AC3: 'the legacy tables stay read-only for their retention period'. FSD P1 A2.17 gives a retention class per Workbench record class but no value for a legacy table.
owner_role: Data steward and data product owner
proposed: Take the period from the retention class of the record class in retention_rule, and name it in the cutover plan.

title: Migration batch states and cutover evidence format are not specified
source: WP B2-P1-005; RWB-DM-006 AC1 and AC3
description: No source names the states of a migration batch or the format of the cutover evidence. Section 9 uses the existing LOV-FRESHNESS values and the AC3 gate only.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-006 gives the extract, reconcile and cut-over steps without state names; TSD P1 T3.8 lists LOV-FRESHNESS (LOADED, STALE) and LOV-PUBLISH-STATUS (PENDING, HELD, RELEASED) and no migration list.
proposed: Add no new list of values; describe the batch by the existing freshness values and the AC3 gate, and record the evidence as the reconciliation extract rows.
